title: About MP-365 (Modern Partners 365)
subtitle: MP-365 (Modern Partners 365) is a Microsoft Solutions Partner and a focused team of specialists. It helps mid-size and enterprise companies get more out of Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 and Copilot.

whoWeAre.title: A small, senior team, not a large consulting firm
whoWeAre.lead: MP-365 works with mid-size and enterprise businesses in construction, manufacturing, healthcare and more. Clients include federal and state government organizations.
story: Large consulting firms come with layers of management and slow-moving processes. MP-365 was built the other way around: a focused team of specialists that jumps in quickly and treats your time as the most valuable asset.

The work centers on Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, integrations with ERP systems, Power Platform, SharePoint automation and Copilot. Every project ends with your team trained and the build documented, so you own what was delivered.
whoWeAre.quote: The goal: your team spends its time on the business, not on the system.

pillars.title: Focused specialists
pillars.desc: A focused team of Microsoft specialists, with no layers of management between you and the people doing the work.

pillars.title: Fast starts
pillars.desc: MP-365 gets access and starts working, with no waiting for kickoff meetings and no long planning phases.

pillars.title: Results you own
pillars.desc: A working first version early, refined with your users, then deployed, documented and handed off to your team.
